newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tamsa sees 1996 sales at 600,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Tamsa sees 1996 sales at 600,000 tonnes.

text.p: Steelmaker Tubos de Acero de Mexico (Tamsa) expects its 1996 sales volumes to reach 600,000 tonnes, a company executive said on Tuesday.

"We should be chalking up 600,000 tonnes... 96 percent of which will be seamless tubing. Our sales will total $600 million and we will export 80 percent of our total volume," Tamsa executive vice president Guillermo Vogel told journalists.
Vogel added that Tamsa planned to increase its production capacity by between 60,000 and 70,000 tonnes per year.
"We have earmarked $50 million for investing in increasing capacity over the next 18 months," Vogel said.
